name: WIC Codec
description: Reads and writes every image format the Windows Imaging Component has a codec for, including JPEG XR (.jxr, .hdp, .wdp) and any WIC codec you install from the Microsoft Store. Formats are discovered from Windows at startup; untick the ones you want left to the built-in decoders in Settings > Plugins.
author: Duong Dieu Phap
